title: MusicXML: multi-staff guitar tracks silently skipped (checks staves[0] only)
description: Per [[musicxml-support]]: convertScore() (SongConverter/src/scoreConverter.ts ~L216) only inspects track.staves[0] to decide if a track is fretted (!staff.isStringed -> skipped.push). Real TuxGuitar 2.1 export (/home/andrew/Music/MusicXML/the-beatles-let_it_be.musicxml) puts standard notation on staff 0 (no tuning, isStringed=false) and the actual tab data on staff 1 (TAB clef, isStringed=true, tuning=[64,59,55,50,45,40]). Result: the only guitar track in a real-world file is pushed entirely into skipped and never converted - not a technique-fidelity gap, a total miss. Confirmed via a throwaway probe test (not committed) running convertMusicXml against the real file; per-track dump showed staff[0].isStringed=false / staff[1].isStringed=true,tuning populated. Fix: scan all of track.staves for one with isStringed (prefer the one with showTablature, matching how TuxGuitar/MuseScore structure multi-staff tab exports) instead of assuming index 0. Blocks real end-to-end validation of ic6's hammer-on/pull-off fix and other Phase 1/5 behaviors against this file.
close_reason: Fixed: convertScore() now scans all of track.staves for one with isStringed (not staff.isPercussion) instead of assuming index 0. Verified against the real TuxGuitar 2.1 export: Guitar track now converts (was fully skipped before), 134 notes, HammerOn=3/PullOff=3 correctly linked (matches source markup, also validates ic6's patch-package fix against real-world data), tuning correctly read as standard EADGBE (all-zero offsets). tsc clean, all 25 existing tests still pass unaffected.

title: MusicXML: patch alphaTab to surface <syllabic> for lyric word-joining (mirror ic6)
description:
Per [[musicxml-support]] lyrics section: alphaTab's MusicXmlImporter._parseLyric (confirmed in installed @coderline/alphatab@1.8.4 dist) only switches on <text>/<elision> child elements - <syllabic> (begin/middle/end) is never referenced anywhere in the function, not even a no-op case branch. Same silent-drop class as harmonic, but recoverable the same way Phase 2's hammer-on/pull-off bug was: a local patch-package patch, verified against our own test suite, then written up as a fork + upstream PR against CoderLine/alphaTab (same workflow already underway for ic6's noteStringLookup fix - explore doing it the same way here).

Decide on patch shape: capture syllabic as a parallel field (e.g. a beat.lyricsSyllabic array alongside beat.lyrics) vs. join at parse time directly (merge a continuing syllable run into one beat.lyrics entry, so consuming code already sees whole words) - the latter is lower-risk, no new public API shape, and mirrors how _parseLyric already appends repeated <text> content within what it currently treats as one entry.

Our own mapping decision either way: SongVocal{Vocal,TimeOffset} has no field for 'continues previous word', so convertMusicXml's own code must end up merging begin/middle/(end) runs into a single SongVocal entry regardless of which alphaTab-side shape is chosen - the schema has nowhere else to carry that signal.

comments.author: Andrew Gwinner
comments.text:
Decided 2026-10-01 (lyrics source selection): auto-pick the track's lyrics when exactly
one part carries non-empty beat.lyrics (the common case, no UI shown). When >1 part has
lyric data (duet/backing-vocal/dual-purpose-track files), show a <select> in the existing
musicxml-metadata-form (main.ts) listing those track names, defaulting to the first -
mirrors the project's existing surface-ambiguity-don't-guess pattern (status-line
skipped-track/known-limits reporting) rather than a naming heuristic that breaks on
duets/choirs.

Still open (multi-syllable words, <lyric><syllabic>): not just a "document it" item -
alphaTab's importer drops <syllabic> entirely (confirmed no-op, same category as harmonic),
so there's no data to read even if we wanted higher fidelity. Real sub-decisions if this
is ever revisited past v1:
  1. Scope: stay with the documented-limitation treatment (separate lyric entries, no
     word-joining - current lean, consistent with slap/pop/harmonic precedent) vs. invest
     in recovering fidelity.
  2. If recovering fidelity: patch alphaTab to surface syllabic (patch-package, same
     category as the Phase 2 noteStringLookup fix) vs. bypass alphaTab's object model for
     this one field and do an independent lightweight scan of the raw <lyric> elements
     ourselves.
  3. Output mapping: SongVocal has no field for "continues previous word" - recovering
     fidelity means merging begin/middle/end runs into one joined Vocal string at
     conversion time, not just tagging entries, since the schema has nowhere else to put it.
Leaning: not worth it for v1 - narrow gap, no schema slot ready for it, and the recovery
paths are comparable effort to Phase 2's harder fixes for a smaller payoff.

title: MusicXML Phase 2: generalize conversion core, fix hammer-on/pull-off
description: Per [[musicxml-support]] Phase 2: add convertMusicXml entry via ScoreLoader.loadScoreFromBytes, settle GpConvertResult naming, handle identically-named parts. Fix the confirmed stale noteStringLookup ordering bug (patch-package two-line re-index in string handler, verify vs project tests) and file the upstream alphaTab issue. Decide patch-vs-workaround per repo upstream-bug pattern.
close_reason:
Local code complete: convertMusicXml entry, Score*/scoreConverter renames, duplicate-part-name fallback, and the noteStringLookup hammer-on/pull-off fix (patches/@coderline+alphatab+1.8.4.patch, patch-package postinstall) all implemented and covered by musicXml.test.ts. Re-verified end-to-end against a real TuxGuitar export (RockyRoadImport-3yj): 3/3 hammer-on + 3/3 pull-off pairs linked correctly.

Upstream fix branch prepared in the fork (/home/andrew/Documents/RockyRoad/alphaTab, branch fix/musicxml-hammer-pull-string-index): the real TS-source fix in MusicXmlImporter.ts's case 'string' handler, plus a new hammer-pull-destination unit+visual reference test (mirrors their existing tie-destination test) - confirmed fails pre-fix (hammer-on slur missing from render) and passes post-fix, tsc/biome clean.

Deferring the actual upstream issue filing/PR: alphaTab's AGENTS.md requires an accepted issue before any PR (symptom-only, no diff/source diagnosis in the issue body) plus a mandatory AI-disclosure block. Holding off on filing until RockyRoadImport-msr's syllabic fix is also ready, so both go upstream together as one batch - will tally how many alphaTab fixes accumulate by the end of this workstream before filing.

comments.author: Andrew Gwinner
comments.text: Implemented 2026-10-01: convertMusicXml entry added; GpConvertResult/GpTrackResult renamed Score*; gpConverter.* renamed scoreConverter.* (main.ts + tests updated). Duplicate part names: no code change, positional fallback proven by test. Hammer fix: patches/@coderline+alphatab+1.8.4.patch via patch-package postinstall, covered by musicXml.test.ts (failed pre-patch, green post). Full suite 23 passed, tsc clean. UPSTREAM DRAFT (paste to CoderLine/alphaTab issues): MusicXML importer: note.string set after Beat.addNote snapshots noteStringLookup, breaking hammer-on/pull-off linking. In MusicXmlImporter _parseTechnical case 'string', the note is already attached to its beat (default string -1 indexed into noteStringLookup), and nothing re-indexes once the real value lands, so Note.finish findHammerPullDestination searches a stale map and clears isHammerPullOrigin. Fix: capture previous string, delete stale entry, set new one (see our patch). Repro: two-note same-string hammer-on pair in .musicxml comes back isHammerPullOrigin/isHammerPullDestination false on 1.8.4.
